prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic background for the closing consultation section of KazProfLab's modern metrology and laboratory consulting website.
Primary request: Create a sophisticated, believable editorial architectural photograph inside a contemporary precision metrology laboratory at blue hour, ultra-wide landscape approximately 2.5:1 (ideally 1920 by 768 pixels).
Scene: a calm, elegant glass-partitioned laboratory corridor recedes into the background with clean metal framing and soft reflected light. On the right third of the composition, an authentic high-end analytical precision balance with a rectangular transparent glass draft shield sits on a dark bench. Inside its draft shield, a small polished cylindrical calibration weight on the weighing pan. Its geometry and construction must feel mechanically real and subtle. This is a precision measurement setting, not a chemistry glassware arrangement.
Composition: the left 55 percent of the image is very dark, calm navy negative space with gentle depth and subdued shadow shapes, free of prominent objects or bright lights, intentionally suitable for a short white text overlay. Camera at workbench height, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, the transparent balance and polished weight sharply resolved on the right; architecture softer behind. The useful instrument is fully inside the right side frame with comfortable margins.
Light and palette: refined cinematic midnight navy and steel blue, tiny restrained cyan reflections in the real glass and brushed metal, soft blue-hour light, natural highlight rolloff, warm white pinpoint detail allowed but no vivid colored accents. Premium corporate editorial photography, material realism, actual photographed optical imperfections, crisp credible glass edges. The image should feel like the end of a coherent laboratory visual story.
Constraints: no people, no human silhouettes, no text, no writing on displays, no readable numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no user interface. No conical flasks, no rows of vials, no duplicate of a chromatography hero shot. No abstract floating objects, no neon beams, no digital circuitry, no artificial glowing technology effects, no CGI/render look, no excessive reflections, no fake gradients. This is solely an original photograph-like background asset, NOT a website mockup.
